runs.name: decide
runs.command: thinkthen decide 'Does the customer ask for a refund?' < ticket.txt
runs.input:
I renewed once this morning, but my card shows two charges.
Please refund the duplicate.
runs.see: The ticket asks for a refund, so decide prints true and exits 0.

runs.name: decide-answer
runs.command: thinkthen decide --details 'Does the customer ask for a refund?' < ticket.txt | jq '.answer'
runs.input:
I renewed once this morning, but my card shows two charges.
Please refund the duplicate.
runs.see: The details put yes at 0.99 for this ticket.

runs.name: decide-vague
runs.command: thinkthen decide 'Does the customer ask for a refund?' < vague.txt
runs.input: I was charged twice. Can you fix this?
runs.see: The vague message still answers true.

runs.name: decide-cut
runs.command: thinkthen decide --threshold 0.9 'Does the customer ask for a refund?' < vague.txt
runs.input: I was charged twice. Can you fix this?
runs.see: At a cut of 0.9 the vague message answers false and exits 1.

runs.name: decide-band
runs.command: thinkthen decide --threshold 0.2:0.8 --details 'Does the customer ask for a refund?' < vague.txt | jq -r '[.value, .answer.probability]|tojson'
runs.input: I was charged twice. Can you fix this?
runs.see: The 0.74 lands inside the 0.2 to 0.8 band, so the value comes back null.
